summary: Conversation header context window and native job timestamps follow the client contract

replay.detail: No replay cursor or spool format changes.

schema.detail: No database tables, indexes, migrations or schema versions change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digests change.

compatibility.detail: The conversation header's context.window is now null instead of true when the transcript window is truncated; cost.window still marks truncation. Native job and tool-start started_at/ended_at values are RFC 3339 UTC millisecond timestamps; epoch-millisecond values are converted and unconvertible values are omitted.

downtime.detail: No coordinated restart or startup work is added.

manual.detail: No configuration or manual action is required.

recovery.detail: No graph recovery or repair is required.
